column1: # Evidence that a message is a Transaction: bank and card alerts, UPI and other transfers, balances, bills and EMIs,
# refunds, order and delivery updates, appointments, tickets and bookings. English and common Latin-script Hinglish.
# Columns (tab separated): group, weight, why (shown to the user in "Why?", so it must be a true statement), regex.
# Regexes are case-insensitive Java regexes and must not contain a tab. Weights: 1.0 is broad, 1.5 and up is specific.
# Every sample used to test these rules is synthetic (app/src/test/resources/classification/transactions.tsv).
